references.text: The original instruction to make braided chains of pure gold for the breastplate, corresponding to the execution described in 39:18.
A parallel instruction describing how the two ends of the braided chains were to be attached to the two filigree settings on the ephod shoulder pieces.
The immediate context describing the making of the braided chains of pure gold and the rings that were attached to the breastplate.
Describes the two shoulder pieces of the ephod to which the chains were to be attached.
Describes the making of the shoulder pieces on the ephod mentioned in verse 18.
Instruction to attach the breastplate to the ephod (28:24) and the actual execution of this joining (39:18).
Instruction to fasten the breastplate securely to the ephod so that it does not come loose, which is completed in 39:18.
